integrity: All analytic proofs use standard Mertens estimates in reduced classes modulo four and tilted independent Bernoulli central limit theorems; numerical checks are finite corroboration, not certification.
scientific_limitations: Sharp asymptotic logarithmic rates only for canonical odd-prime cutoffs; no finite-effective rate, no density rate for the original Romanoff representation problem, and earlier implicit general large-deviation coverage remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp large-deviation rates for the two exceptional sets in a prime-square Romanoff sieve
